properties.name: Nyugati külterület
properties.approximationNote: Broad source-map outer groups approximated by the depicted north/west/east/south sectors. Current OSM municipal outline supplies the outer frame; registered source built-up groups are removed. Sector connectors are rough manual links, not printed legal divider lines. Only the connected area associated with the printed group number is selected.
